name: L. Ayers
role: Northern Pacific engineer on the Medora slaughter house; gun club member
bio: L. Ayers supervised construction at Medora for the Northern Pacific in the winter of 1884-85, which the paper later described as the building of the slaughter house, and he shot with the Bad Lands Gun Club. By October 1885 he was in Duluth, and in December 1886 the paper listed him among old-timers as a civil engineer there.
